Cell p71, bottom row second from left: Mina on the RIGHT offers a warm cup; Ren on the LEFT receives it with his LEFT hand while the bandaged RIGHT forearm rests safely on the table. Keep the repaired tent and wash basin visible in sparse background.
Cell p72, bottom row leftmost: Mina looks from the repaired awning to Ren on the LEFT, then places a dry cloth beside the empty entrance hook on the RIGHT. Ren follows her gaze and nods; the single tag remains on his belt. End with the empty hook and belt tag both legible as one each.

Leave a clean white strip near the upper horizontal edge of every cell for later short vertical speech balloons. Do not make a long continuous scene and do not merge cells.
Text: Render absolutely no text, no numbers, no dialogue, no captions, no speech balloons, no sound effects, no lettering, no watermark. All lettering will be added later in HTML.
